name: Modelling And Control Of Multi Mobile Robots
desc: Working on model predictive control to control a group of multiple mobile robots and generate online trajectories in real time while avoiding collision with static point obstacles and other robots. On-demand Collision avoidance method is used to avoid collision and a replanning strategy is to be used to avoid disturbances to the system.

name: Segregation And Flocking of Heterogeneous Robotic Swarms With Potential Field
desc: Implementation of the paper Segregation of Heterogeneous Units in a Swarm of Robotic Agents Authors-Manish Kumar; Devendra P. Garg; Vijay Kumar. The concept of Artificial Potential Field has been studied for the application to the segregation and flocking of a group of robotic agents.
